connector.name: Sheetsdata MCP
connector.registryDescription: Electronic component datasheets for AI agents - specs, pinouts, package data on demand.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.sheetsdata.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the octoco-ltd account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: SHEETSDATA_API_KEY
env.description: Optional — if omitted, OAuth login opens in your browser. Get a key at https://sheetsdata.com/dashboard/keys
